records.title: 10-K
records.text: Our net revenues were $444.5 million and $651.1 million in 2023 and 2022, respectively.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: These sources of cash were partially offset by a $27.7 million increase in inventories due to softening demand during the year, a $18.2 million decrease in taxes payable and accrued liabilities, a $5.4 million decrease in accounts payable (excluding payables related to property and equipment) due to timing of payments and a $1.2 million increase in prepaid expenses and other assets.
